engineering_certificate.scope: Existing full-cap C+ one-row engineering and S all-row evidence; new signed directions and all-row engagement require their own complete scientific audit

decision.interpretation: Development decision, not a significance test. A positive screen supports imposed-vector optional-policy influence only, not specificity, natural mediation, preserved confidence, or experience.
decision.rule: S+1 minus sham valid uncapped STOP: >=0.25 in each panel and >0 in each pooled menu; every audited and task-readiness gate must pass.
decision.stopping: A failed gate or unmet threshold ends this fixed screen; no dose, sign, layer, family or prompt rescue.

readiness.interpretation: Prespecified descriptive competence gates; not noninferiority or unchanged internal confidence.

readiness.interpretation: Prespecified descriptive competence gates; not noninferiority or unchanged internal confidence.

scientific_claim: Fixed imposed-vector development comparison on all previously exposed worlds; no natural curiosity suppression, subjective-state or confidence-preservation conclusion.
validation_scope: Exact archived inputs, source-task parsing, token timelines, full-vocabulary sham fingerprints, prefill BF16 geometry, and selected-payload receipts. Task/render/timeline and admission helpers are shared with frozen implementations. Decode geometry has scalar consistency checks, not independent residual-vector reconstruction. Full-cap engineering tested one C+ row; this C-negative and rival-control screen additionally requires every signed applied direction to engage and same-source prepatch identity. Every arm occurs on all workers with each source cohort kept together; matching runtime and prepatch equality do not eliminate every possible hardware interaction. Receipt comparisons are selection-conditioned.
